lines.text: She copied my croissant. My font. Even my cat!

lines.speaker: kane
lines.text: Then... we watch her. Legally. Public pages only. Zero dollars.

lines.speaker: kane
lines.text: Clue one: changedetection.io. Her prices change? You know in a minute.

lines.speaker: kane
lines.text: Clue two: RSSHub and Miniflux. Every post she makes, in one feed.

lines.speaker: kane
lines.text: Clue three: Ollama. An AI on your own laptop reads it all... and writes your briefing.

lines.speaker: kane
lines.text: She launches Friday. You launch Thursday.

lines.speaker: june
lines.text: A year of copying me... and now she's a day behind!
